slots.label: Heading 1
slots.default: Your people are the first line of defence

slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: Technical security controls have limitations. Most successful attacks begin with human interaction, a convincing phishing email, an unexpected phone call, or a genuine-looking login page. When someone believes a message is real, the strongest firewall in the world won’t help.

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: We help organisations reduce risk through practical training that addresses how employees actually work, using real examples rather than technical theory, so staff can recognise suspicious activity and know exactly what to do.

slots.label: Paragraph 3
slots.default: Training runs as an ongoing programme rather than a single session, with simulated phishing and reporting so you can see which teams need attention. Everything runs through the same UK service desk that handles your day-to-day tickets, so there is no separate team to chase. Across 2025 our average first response time was 9 minutes and our average resolution time was 6 hours, measured across every ticket we handled.
